label: Rival: something moves another in a… alternative to A thing moves another in some respect…
note: Class: not yet attackable. On the formal reading of act the rival is the strongest objection to the premise; on the virtual reading an emergent cause is in act virtually and the rival does not bite, but then the non-simultaneity premise must hold for virtual act (DISAMB-IN-ACT). Missing: a pinned or bibliographic witness (Broad 1925, candidate BROAD-MIND-AND-ITS-PLACE-CH2, #378) and a fixed sense of act.
